acceptedRequirements: Every highlighted socket must have a solid fill, not a hollow ring. Applies to actual hover/active/connection-origin/keyboard-highlight states introduced or retained.

Human delegates bounded appearance choices; Legacy glow is not the required exact appearance and needs stronger visibility. Preserve readable idle versus hover versus active versus keyboard focus states.

Aesthetic implementation may use a localized violet/lavender glow and brighter solid center, stronger during active connection, rather than selection green. This is the Coordinator proposed engineering direction within delegated style choice, not a required pixel/color recipe.

Socket button remains on the socket circle, labels separate. Glow/outline cannot move layout or wire endpoints and must not cover adjacent input controls. Preserve accessible socket naming, keyboard operation and existing port/type semantics.
proof: Capture meaningful idle/hover/active/keyboard states with actual trusted input at narrow/desktop/fractional zoom; assert solid fill and unchanged centers/body geometry, normal hit targets and connection cancellation.
referenceBoundary: Observe Legacy interactions/layout only; do not copy its DOM/implementation or whole style sheet.
